faq_heading: Homes near Annieville Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Annieville Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Annieville Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Annieville Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Annieville Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 48 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,062,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Annieville Elementary?
faq.a: Near Annieville Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 22 days to sell and closed at 95.3% of the list price, with 4% over asking, across 48 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Annieville Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Delview Secondary (0.5 km south-east), Gibson Elementary (0.5 km south-east) and Devon Gardens Elementary (0.8 km south-west).

Annieville Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 9240 112 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Annieville Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Annieville Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Annieville Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Annieville Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 48 homes sold within 1 km of Annieville Elementary: 40 houses. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,062,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Annieville Elementary

21 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Annieville Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 5 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Delview Secondary, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Queen Elizabeth Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Gibson Elementary (0.5 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Devon Gardens Elementary (0.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Gibson Elementary (0.5 km south-east), Devon Gardens Elementary (0.8 km south-west), Royal Heights Elementary (1.2 km north-east), Hellings Elementary (1.3 km south-east), Immaculate Conception School (1.4 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Gibson Elementary, 0.5 km south-east of Annieville Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Annieville Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Annieville Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Annieville Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Annieville Elementary was $1,062,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Gibson Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.5 km south-east of Annieville Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
